FN-YLZV226-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 83
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 83 as introduced would increase the obligations of the state and local entities
constructing new or renovating existing public restrooms where the cost to renovate is at least
$500,000, by an estimated minimum of $15,000 to provide for: (1) the installation of an
adult-size changing table; and (2) signage indicating the location of the restrooms with the
changing table.
The increased obligations of the state and local entities installing the adult-size changing tables,
could be offset by grant funds made available via legislative appropriation.

FN-YLZV226-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 83
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 83 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would increase
the obligations of the state and local entities constructing new, or renovating existing public
restrooms, where the cost to renovate is at least $500,000, by an estimated minimum of $15,000
to provide for: (1) the installation of an adult-size changing table; and (2) signage indicating the
location of the restrooms with the changing table. Beginning with fiscal year 2031, and every
three years thereafter, this bill would provide for an increase in the minimum required cost to
renovate an existing public restroom based on the percentage increase in the Consumer Price
Index for the immediately preceding three-year period.
The increased obligations of the state and local entities installing the adult-size changing tables,
could be offset by grant funds made available via legislative appropriation.

FN-YLZV226-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 83
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/12/2025
Senate Bill 83 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of state and local entities
constructing or renovating public restrooms under certain conditions by an estimated minimum
of $15,000 for each adult-size changing table required to be installed in certain public buildings
pursuant to this bill beginning in fiscal year 2028.
These increased obligations could be offset by grants awarded from legislative appropriations,
as provided by this bill.
This bill would have an estimated aggregate fiscal impact of greater than $50,000 annually on
affected local government entities and is subject to the provisions of Section 111.05 of the
Constitution of Alabama of 2023.
